_comment: The only file to edit by hand. build.py reads it, then pulls everything else from the GitHub API. A new repository appears automatically under `default_kind` — give it a kind here to file it properly, and a blurb if GitHub's description is too long for the table.

blurbs.DeckTok: Controller-first TikTok client for the Steam Deck — TikTok's web client in a gamepad-driven Electron shell.
blurbs.steamdeck-waydroid-setup: Reproducing a working Waydroid (Android 13) install on SteamOS: AUR build, GAPPS, ARM translation, Widevine, Play certification.
blurbs.python-autoclicker: Lightweight autoclicker with a GUI — configurable interval, toggle hotkey, left/right click. Built for Linux and SteamOS.
blurbs.xcloudwrapper: Xbox Cloud Gaming as a native macOS app. Hardened Electron window, no telemetry, universal binary.
blurbs.izzytok: A custom TikTok frontend that shows one creator and nothing else.
blurbs.TIMECLOCK: Minimal browser time clock for tracking hours and calculating pay at a fixed rate.
blurbs.discord-bot: Greed-inspired open source all-purpose Discord bot.
blurbs.discord-username-scraper: Username generator and availability checker against Discord's public API.
blurbs.whatever: A tiny terminal typing-speed test. Nothing beyond the Python standard library.
blurbs.blockfall: Single-file 3D wave shooter in Three.js — 11 biomes, 9 weapons, multi-phase bosses, sandbox mode.
blurbs.sandbox3d: Physics sandbox with 40+ spawnable objects, built on Three.js and cannon-es.
blurbs.sandbox: A Three.js sandbox game in the spirit of Garry's Mod.
blurbs.hyphae-game: A dark, fungal idle game — grow a mycelium network across an abandoned city.
blurbs.sam-is-online: A short narrative chat game in the spirit of Emily Is Away. Plain HTML, CSS and JS.
blurbs.ballbattles: Two ball 'battlers' fight in a zero-gravity arena. 9:16 layout, ability registry, synth sound.
blurbs.hydro: Browser gaming site with 500+ instant-play games — no downloads, no sign-ups.
blurbs.everyfile.sys: Recreation of PortalRunner's “flash drive with literally every file” video, in HTML.
blurbs.random-archive: Press the button, get a random thing out of archive.org.
blurbs.passwordgameautoplay: Userscript that plays neal.fun's The Password Game by itself, rule 1 to the win screen.
blurbs.cookieclickerautoplay: Cookie Clicker autopilot that only does what a human could, aiming at 100% achievements.
blurbs.aura: One-page site for Aura Club and Conventions, a nightlife venue in Naperville, Illinois.
blurbs.site: One-page site for Mall of India, Naperville, Illinois.
blurbs.site2: The Mall of India site with its images bundled in the repository.
blurbs.fnbots: Static one-page list of 30 Fortnite bot account names.
blurbs.cdn: Image and GIF assets used by my other sites.
blurbs.moicdn: Image assets for the Mall of India site.
